title: The Chalkbone Plate
summary: Something to wear out of the Rings, ground the same way as the cleaver.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now grind chalkbone bar and cartilage shard into a chalkbone plate, body armour to go with the cleaver.

items.name: Chalkbone plate
items.examine: Fused chalkbone, strapped on where the ribs used to flex.
